title: Leading exponents and coefficients multiply for a monomial order
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $r\geq1$, and $S=k[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let $\prec$ be a total well-order on $\mathbf N^r$, with $0$ least, preserved by addition. For $h\ne0$, write $\operatorname{LM}(h)$ for the greatest support exponent and $\operatorname{LC}(h)$ for its coefficient, and set $\operatorname{LM}(0)=0$, $\operatorname{LC}(0)=0$. If $f,g\in S$ are nonzero, then $\operatorname{LM}(fg)=\operatorname{LM}(f)+\operatorname{LM}(g)$. For all $f,g\in S$, one has $\operatorname{LC}(fg)=\operatorname{LC}(f)\operatorname{LC}(g)$.
